about_the_game:
One of the Many is a thrilling top-down hack-and-slash inspired by classic ARPGs like Diablo. Assume the role of the Great Entity, an ancient power weakened by the Orc invasion. With your realm conquered and your army long gone, you can only resurrect one fallen champion at a time to fight back. Each time a hero falls, another takes their place, one of the many lost souls who still heed your call.

Key Features

  • Multiple Hero Classes – Choose from four distinct classes: Ranger, Mage, Knight, and Barbarian. Each offers unique abilities and different playstyles to master.

  • Dungeon-Crawling Progression – Battle through successive dungeon levels, vanquishing formidable bosses to reclaim your lost throne.

  • Permadeath with a Twist – When a hero dies, another rises to take their place. Each fallen champion leaves behind experience and improvements that strengthen the next.

  • Upgradeable Abilities – Enhance and customize your champions with upgrades that boost skills, stats, and gear.

  • Immersive Dark Fantasy Setting – Explore the once-glorious realm of the Great Entity, now corrupted by Orcs. Recover the remnants of your power and cleanse the dungeons of their invaders.

Will you gather enough strength to reclaim your throne from the depths? One of the Many delivers a fast-paced dark fantasy experience filled with intense battles, strategic class choices, and the relentless push for victory! One resurrected champion at a time.
